VR.title: XREAL’s First Budget AR Glasses Go on Sale Internationally, Priced at $300
VR.summary: XREAL's budget AR glasses, the xbx a01+, are now available internationally for $300, marking a significant step in affordable XR technology.

VR.title: Lamborghini’s Apple Vision Pro App Reimagines the Showroom at Home
VR.summary: Lamborghini launched a free Apple Vision Pro app that offers immersive showcases of its rare vehicles, allowing users to experience them in their homes.

VR.title: Meta Reaffirms "Multiple Next-Generation Headsets", Hints At Connect Announcement
VR.summary: Meta's CTO confirmed ongoing development of multiple next-generation headsets, hinting at a potential reveal during the upcoming Connect event.

VR.title: VR/MR Puzzler Squingle Arcade Is Out Today On Meta Quest For Free
VR.summary: The fast-paced VR/MR puzzle game Squingle Arcade is now available for free on Meta Quest, featuring innovative hand tracking support.

VR.title: ‘Tomb Raider’ VR Reportedly Cancelled According to Leaked Images & Video
VR.summary: Leaked images indicate that Vertigo Games was developing a Tomb Raider VR game before its cancellation earlier this year.

VR.title: ‘Pistol Whip’ Studio Reportedly Developing “impossible to ignore” Multiplayer VR Game
VR.summary: Cloudhead Games, known for Pistol Whip, is reportedly developing a multiplayer VR game that may include a flatscreen mode.

AI.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-5.6 after government greenlight — and announces ‘ChatGPT Work’
AI.summary: OpenAI has rolled out GPT-5.6 after receiving government approval, marking a significant update to its AI capabilities.

AI.title: Google will now tell you if an ad was made with AI
AI.summary: Google has introduced a new feature that labels ads created or edited with AI, enhancing transparency for users.

AI.title: Fidji Simo steps down from leading OpenAI’s AGI work due to illness
AI.summary: OpenAI's Fidji Simo steps down from her role as AGI chief due to health issues, transitioning to a part-time advisory position.

AI.title: Meta says its new AI model is ready to compete on coding
AI.summary: Meta has launched an updated AI model, Muse Spark 1.1, designed to enhance coding capabilities for developers.

AI.title: The ChatGPT browser is already dead
AI.summary: OpenAI is shutting down its ChatGPT Atlas browser service less than a year after its launch, as part of a broader restructuring.

AI.title: FL Studio 2026 turns its AI chatbot into your assistant engineer
AI.summary: FL Studio 2026 has upgraded its AI chatbot, Gopher, transforming it into a more interactive assistant for music production.

NFL.title: Commanders to retire No. 44 of HOF RB Riggins
NFL.summary: The Washington Commanders will retire the No. 44 jersey of Hall of Famer John Riggins, honoring his legacy over 40 years after his iconic Super Bowl run.

NFL.title: Clutch Vinatieri to enter Colts' Ring of Honor
NFL.summary: Kicker Adam Vinatieri, set to enter the Pro Football Hall of Fame, will also be inducted into the Colts' Ring of Honor on October 18.

NFL.title: Study: NFLers die from dementia at higher rate
NFL.summary: A new study reveals NFL players are four times more likely to die from neurodegenerative diseases like dementia compared to the general population.

NFL.title: Raiders owner Mark Davis is committed to grass "for safety purposes"
NFL.summary: Raiders owner Mark Davis is committed to maintaining a grass playing surface for player safety, highlighting the importance of field conditions.

NFL.title: At age 36, Cam Heyward led the NFL in snaps at defensive tackle
NFL.summary: At 36, Steelers defensive tackle Cam Heyward led the NFL in snaps, showcasing remarkable endurance for an older player in the league.

NFL.title: Rams will give replica Super Bowl LXVI rings to fans who attend Week 6 game vs. Cardinals
NFL.summary: The Rams will commemorate their Super Bowl LXVI victory by giving replica championship rings to fans attending their Week 6 game against the Cardinals.
